functions.name: PackCaptureMatrixRegisters
functions.comment: Packs three matrix rows into six auxiliary-register words. Three signed coefficients use magnitude Q16>>6 and sign bit12, requiring |coefficient| < 4.0 to avoid overlapping the sign/fields. Fourth row element occupies upper16 of second word. Shared prologue/epilogue require the Kodak compiler model.
functions.status: static-analysis finding; inferred names, ABI needs review unless explicitly typed

comments.comment: SetScene table (SCN starts at High ISO): index->mode [21,5,4,3,6,15,10,11,13,16,12,17,7,9,14,22]. Museum index11=17; Children index13=9; final item index15=22 (user calls it Sunset). Early notes were off by one in naming.
Mode switch dispatches flash reset via table at 0x3c682. Treat as code location, not assumed function entry.
Stock colour jump table bytes [9,13,3,17,19]. VIVID patch changes byte at 0x445e2 from 19 to 3.
Known unreferenced zero run through 0x125cef; fullscreen uses 0x125420..0x1255ff, scene_films 0x125600..0x125960. Stock project: do not patch.
Code zero tail through 0x130000. Candidate code/data cave; do not treat zeros as functions.
